title: Virtual Camera Frog Offline image
description: Makes the Virtual Camera's offline image the frog animation from that Minecraft Live
body:
This resourcepack was made for the mod [Virtual Camera](https://modrinth.com/mod/virtualcamera) , and without it this resourcepack does nothing.

This resourcepack was made to reduce the mod's size, and is only relevant in and after version ```26.6.3``` of Virtual Camera, and it makes the off image of the Camera be the **Frog animation from Minecraft Live 2022**.

If you want a different off animation, you can use this online tool to create one from a video or image:
https://tggamesyt.dev/offpack
